payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition of the problem of session segmentation in conversation systems, highlighting its importance and the challenges associated with it.

claims.text: The problem of session segmentation involves retaining relevant context utterances while eliminating irrelevant ones in long conversation sessions.
Traditional document segmentation methods are not suitable for conversation session segmentation due to the unique characteristics of dialogue.
The proposed solution enhances traditional segmentation methods with modern embedding-based similarity measures to improve robustness in noisy conversation data.
